sentences.text: Hopleacanthus was a cartilaginous fish, a member of the class Chondrichthyes, living during the Permian period.
This animal belongs to the parent group Neoselachii.

Fossils of this genus have been found in the Kupferschiefer formation in Germany. The type species is Hopleacanthus richelsdorfensis, and there is currently only one recorded fossil occurrence of the genus.
